tasks.label: cleanup-root-npm-artifacts

tasks.label: free-port-5000
args: $conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($conn) { $pids = $conn | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; foreach ($id in $pids) { Write-Output "Stopping PID $id on port 5000"; Stop-Process -Id $id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } else { Write-Output "No active listener on port 5000" }; $remaining = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($remaining) { Write-Output "Port 5000 is still in use" } else { Write-Output "Port 5000 is now free" }

tasks.label: check-port-5000
args: $conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($conn) { $conn | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize } else { Write-Output "PORT_5000_FREE" }

tasks.label: check-common-dev-ports
args: $ports = 5000,5001,5002,5003,3000,5173; foreach ($p in $ports) { $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($c) { Write-Output "$p IN_USE" } else { Write-Output "$p FREE" } }

tasks.label: scan-server-ports
args: $ports = 5002..5010; foreach ($p in $ports) { $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($c) { Write-Output "$p IN_USE" } else { Write-Output "$p FREE" } }

tasks.label: check-port-5006
args: $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5006 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($c) { $c | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize } else { Write-Output 'PORT_5006_FREE' }

tasks.label: free-stale-server-port
args: Stop-Process -Id 19268 -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5006 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($c) { Write-Output 'PORT_5006_STILL_IN_USE' } else { Write-Output 'PORT_5006_FREE' }

tasks.label: confirm-port-5006-free
args: $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5006 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($c) { $c | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize } else { Write-Output 'PORT_5006_FREE' }

tasks.label: recheck-port-5006-free
args: $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5006 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($c) { $c | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize } else { Write-Output 'PORT_5006_FREE' }
